property_summary: For any call to transfer(from, caddress, tos, v), the callee at caddress must observe a call whose calldata decodes to transferFrom(from, tos[0], v), since the reference always delivers the call for tos[0] while the mutant skips it whenever tos.length == 1 (index starts at 1).
change_summary: Start the loop index at 1, so when _tos.length == 1 the call is skipped and no external call is made.
